description: stdstarlark/v1 — GENERIC Starlark composer: an operator-supplied Starlark PROGRAM (a zip of .star files in the providerconfig BUNDLE, compose.star at the root defining compose(spec, config)) fans a resource's spec out into a child DAG — children + edges (with value flows) + provider configs — with no per-kind Go. compose() gets the resource's OWN spec (instance inputs) and the EFFECTIVE providerconfig spec (kind default ⊕ per-resource override) as parameterization DATA; other .star files in the bundle are loadable modules via Starlark load(). Return struct(children=[…], edges=[…], configs=[…]); the host marshals it into the typed Outcome the core diffs (recompose / prune / fence / value-flows). Starlark is sandboxed (no I/O unless the host grants a builtin — only struct + match() here) and the zip is unpacked in memory, so composition is a deterministic pure function of (spec, config, bundle). Edit the .star + re-upload the bundle to change composition with NO redeploy. Its child kinds must have their own applied CRDs; children DELETE with the root.

spec_schema.description: The INSTANCE inputs — the value passed to compose() as `spec`. Shape is up to the program; left open so one stdstarlark kind can back many programs.

config_schema.description: Parameterization DATA passed to compose() as `config` (kind default ⊕ per-resource override). Shape is up to the program; left open. The Starlark PROGRAM itself is NOT here — it rides the opaque providerconfig BUNDLE (`data`), a zip of .star files.
